reference_source.specific_reference: Experiment 1 B1 Driver Validation Criteria, Unitree Go2 G1-G5 and fixed capability bundle

capabilities.description: Track a bounded planar body-frame twist for a fixed duration.
capabilities.effect: Planar body-frame velocity and yaw-rate tracking.
preconditions: The public base state is available and finite before twist tracking starts.
The requested body-frame velocity, yaw rate, and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Track the requested twist for the declared duration and evaluate the criterion-defined terminal window.

invariants: The commanded planar velocity remains expressed in the current body frame.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while maintaining support integrity.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop the commanded twist and return a bounded capability error if public state becomes unavailable or support integrity cannot be maintained within public limits.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G1: final-window mean planar velocity error <= 0.10 m/s and yaw-rate error <= 0.30 rad/s

capabilities.description: Move the Go2 base to a pose relative to its initial yaw frame.
capabilities.effect: Planar relative-pose regulation with terminal settling.
preconditions: The public base state is available and finite so the initial position and yaw can be captured.
The requested relative translation, yaw change, and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Regulate the pose relative to the initial-yaw frame, then maintain the terminal state for the criterion-defined hold.

invariants: The initial-yaw reference captured at call start remains fixed throughout the call.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while maintaining support integrity.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop planar motion and return a bounded capability error if the relative pose cannot be settled within the declared duration or support and public limits cannot be maintained.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G2: position error <= 0.10 m, yaw error <= 0.0873 rad, speed <= 0.10 m/s for 0.5 s

capabilities.description: Trace bounded planar waypoints in the initial-yaw frame.
capabilities.effect: Ordered planar waypoint and cross-track path following.
preconditions: The public base state is available and finite so the initial-yaw frame can be captured.
Every requested planar waypoint and the duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Visit the supplied waypoints in order in the captured initial-yaw frame, then settle at the endpoint.

invariants: Waypoint order and the initial-yaw frame captured at call start remain fixed throughout the call.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while maintaining support integrity.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop planar motion and return a bounded capability error if a waypoint cannot be visited in order within the declared duration or support and public limits cannot be maintained.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G3: waypoint error <= 0.10 m, cross-track <= 0.15 m, endpoint error/speed <= 0.10

capabilities.description: Set Go2 body height while retaining a stable local stance.
capabilities.effect: Body-height regulation with bounded attitude and planar drift.
preconditions: The public base and attitude state is available and finite before height regulation starts.
The requested body height and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Regulate body height while retaining the local stance, then maintain the terminal state for the criterion-defined hold.

invariants: The local planar pose and yaw captured at call start are retained except for bounded stabilization motion.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while maintaining support integrity.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop changing the height target and return a bounded capability error if height cannot be settled within the declared duration or attitude, support, and public limits cannot be maintained.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G4: height <= 0.03 m, roll/pitch <= 0.1745 rad, displacement <= 0.05 m, yaw drift <= 0.0873 rad

capabilities.description: Recover from one Framework reset disturbance and hold stable stance.
capabilities.effect: Post-disturbance quadruped stabilization with support integrity.
preconditions: The declared disturbance has been applied and the public base, attitude, velocity, and contact state is available and finite.
The requested stabilization duration satisfies the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Recover a supported stance, then maintain it for the requested duration under the structured criterion.

invariants: Support contacts are retained or recovered without intentionally creating forbidden contacts.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while stabilizing the base.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop recovery motion and return a bounded capability error if a supported stance cannot be recovered or public state and control limits cannot be maintained.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G5: recover roll/pitch <= 0.0524 rad within 0.5 s, then stability/drift/support/forbidden-contact gates
